Items.Subject: Wifi code for visiting contractor
Items.Body: A contractor is onsite with us for the next four days and needs internet for her demo laptop. How do I get her connected and can the access cover her whole visit?

Items.Subject: Suspicious email pretending to be IT
Items.Body: I received an email claiming to be from IT support asking me to verify my password via a link. I have NOT clicked anything. What's the right way to report this so others don't fall for it?

Items.Subject: Former employee needs last two payslips
Items.Body: I left HomeFix in June and need my final two payslips for a mortgage application. My network account is disabled. How do I get these documents?

Items.Subject: Day 4 and still missing ERP access + design software
Items.Body: I started Monday and still can't open the ERP or install the design tool my manager said was pre-approved. Two questions: how do I get the ERP access sorted, and where do I install approved software from?

Items.Subject: Home internet reimbursement for remote staff
Items.Body: I'm fully remote as of this month. Does HomeFix reimburse a portion of home internet costs, and if so how do I claim it? I couldn't find anything in Concur categories.

Items.Subject: Badge readers down at Austin HQ, exec visit at 2pm
Items.Body: Both badge readers at the Austin HQ main entrance stopped working and employees are queued outside. We have a customer executive visit at 2pm today. Need this fixed or a workaround immediately.

Items.Subject: Cedar room AV failed during customer demo again
Items.Body: The video bar in AUS-3F-Cedar dropped the call twice during a customer demo this month. Sales is furious. If this room can't be fixed properly I want it escalated to whoever owns AV, not another reboot.

Items.Subject: Scheduled maintenance notification - HR portal
Items.Body: This is an automated notification. The HR portal will undergo scheduled maintenance on Saturday from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. No action is required. Do not reply to this message.
